title: schedonorus eskia
intro: Schedonorus eskia, commonly known as timothy grass, is a perennial grass species native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of timothy grass include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulator, making it useful for treating conditions such as arthritis and allergies. The bioactive constituents of timothy grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
